name: sitebulb-desktop
description: Technical SEO skills and read-only access to your Sitebulb Desktop audits: audit summaries, hints and insights, URL-level data, change-over-time comparisons, prioritised fixes, client audit documents and dev tickets.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to Sitebulb Desktop to explore the technical SEO audits stored on your Windows or Mac computer. Ask about audit summaries, hints and insights, affected URLs, the data for a single URL, and what changed between audits. Five built-in skills turn that data into prioritised fix lists, change reports, client-ready audit documents, dev tickets and post-release checks. Access is read-only, so it can't start crawls or change settings, and Sitebulb Desktop needs to be open and running on your computer. For Sitebulb Cloud audits, use the separate Sitebulb Cloud plugin.
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first on this site?
What changed since the last crawl?
Write up the audit for my client

positive.description: List the projects in the connected account
positive.prompt: Which projects do I have in Sitebulb?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the projects in the connected Sitebulb Desktop installation by name and URL, including "Example Project A".

positive.prompt: What should I fix first on Example Project A?
positive.tools_triggered: project_list, project_audit_list, audit_report_list, audit_hint_category_list, audit_hint_list, audit_url_list
positive.expected_behavior: First asks a few short questions about the business and its goals. Once those are answered (any reasonable answers will do), returns 3 to 5 prioritised issue clusters from the latest finished audit, each with its true affected URL count, sample URLs and an effort estimate. No hints are invented.

positive.prompt: What changed since the last crawl of Example Project B?
positive.tools_triggered: project_list, project_audit_list, audit_report_list, audit_report_summary, audit_lostfound_hint_list, audit_hint_category_list, audit_hint_list, audit_lostfound_url_list
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the latest finished audit of Example Project B with the one before it and reports improvements first, then regressions, then items to watch, with per-hint changes and sample URLs. Bookkeeping noise is filtered out. If little has changed between the two audits, it says so plainly rather than padding the report.

positive.prompt: Write up the technical SEO audit for Example Project A. It's an onboarding audit for a new client's marketing manager.
positive.tools_triggered: project_list, project_audit_list, audit_report_list, audit_hint_category_list, audit_hint_list, audit_url_list
positive.expected_behavior: Produces a Word document draft of 5 to 10 issues ordered for an onboarding audit, each with its affected URL count, labelled sample URLs, a recommendation and indicative effort, plus review comments marking where the consultant should check the draft.

positive.description: Dev tickets without a project management tool (sitebulb-dev-handoff skill)
positive.prompt: Turn the high severity link issues in the latest Example Project A audit into dev tickets.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of each ticket in chat (problem, why it matters, affected URL count with samples, suggested fix, acceptance criteria, priority and effort). With no project management tool connected, the tickets are returned as markdown and nothing is created elsewhere.

negative.description: Starting a crawl is not supported
negative.prompt: Crawl competitor.com for me and tell me what's wrong with it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin is read-only and cannot start crawls, and that audits are run in the Sitebulb Desktop app. No tool performs a crawl.

negative.prompt: Delete the oldest audit from Example Project A.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot delete or change audits or projects. No data is modified.

negative.prompt: Show me the audits for a project that belongs to another Sitebulb customer.
negative.expected_behavior: Only projects in the connected Sitebulb Desktop installation are returned; the request for another customer's data is declined or reported as not found.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It requires an existing Sitebulb Desktop licence, which is purchased on sitebulb.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: initial release. Read-only access to Sitebulb Desktop audits (projects, audit summaries, hints, insights, URL-level data and comparisons between audits), plus five technical SEO skills: what to fix first, what changed, technical SEO audit, dev handoff and release check.
